name: Tower Hamlets Plan 2031 Managing Growth and Sharing Benefits

housing-numbers.notes: Total target is 58,965 homes (2016-2031) equating to 3,931 homes per year. Plan states majority of housing will come from allocated sites but specific allocated housing numbers not clearly stated in extracted pages. Windfall allowance of 3,122 is distributed across sub-areas. Housing distributed across four sub-areas: Isle of Dogs and South Poplar (31,209), City Fringe (10,334), Lower Lea Valley (5,748), Central (7,597).
